slides.title: Executive Summary — Why Leasing, Why Now
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential

bullets.text: The annuity gap: we sell fleets to lessors (Yelo: 15,500+ Changan, 5,000+ Hyundai/Genesis) — the lease profit, data and remarketing leave the group
Saudi long-term leasing: SAR 4.3bn (2025E) → SAR 8.55bn (2031F), ~11.3% CAGR — fastest-growing recurring pool in the value chain
Consolidating market: top-4 operators hold ~53% of revenue; the middle market (SMEs, regional corporates) is still open
Window: the current pre-IPO price war is temporary — entering after consolidation is harder and costlier

slides.notes: Lead with the gap: we already supply 20,000+ vehicles to a single lessor. The recommendation is corporate-first, consumer delayed behind gates.

shapes.text: RECOMMENDATION — Option A+: corporate-first operating lease in 2027 (Auto Lease + Used Lead); consumer Quick/Fix Lead behind a KPI gate; full-stack + financing deferred to 2029+

slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential

slides.title: Auto Lead — Four Lines Mapped to Demand Pools
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential
slides.notes: Auto Lease is the Phase-1 core; Used Lead supports from day one; Quick/Fix monetize after the fleet exists.

shapes.text: AUTO LEASE — Corporate operating lease, full service (PHASE 1 CORE)
QUICK LEAD — Monthly consumer subscription (PHASE 2)
FIX LEAD — Service & maintenance plans (PHASE 2 ADD-ON)
USED LEAD — Certified pre-owned for lease returns (DAY-ONE SUPPORT)
Corporates, government, giga-project contractors — 87% of leased-fleet demand
Individuals, SMEs, new arrivals — digital app-first delivery
Existing service-loyalty base — Hyundai/Changan workshops already in-network
Lease-return remarketing — end of a USD 24.5bn used market (1.6M txns/yr)
Regulatory path: TGA licenses rental/leasing activity • SAMA review triggered only if any product embeds consumer credit (Fix Lead payment plans — legal opinion first)

slides.title: From One Margin to Five — The Annuity Logic
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential
slides.notes: Today layer 1 is the whole P&L. A leasing arm layers 2–5 on vehicles we already sell and service. GIB via Ken Research: long-term contracts ≈45% of listed lessors' revenue mix.

shapes.text: 1. Vehicle Sale — TODAY
2. Lease Yield
3. Service & Maintenance
4. Remarketing (Used)
5. Fleet Data & Telematics
TODAY: one-time margin — layers 2–5 accrue to lessors (e.g., Yelo) buying our vehicles
TARGET: full five-layer annuity on vehicles we already sell, service and remarket
Long-term contracts ≈ 45% of listed lessors' 2025–26 revenue mix (GIB Capital via Ken Research) — recurring revenue is where the sector's margin is moving

slides.title: Strategic Fit — Why AlMajdouie Can Win This
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential

bullets.text: Annuity stacking — converts episodic vehicle sales into 1–5 year contracted revenue on our own brands
Demand we control — AlMajdouie group companies (logistics, industrial, real estate) are anchor operating-lease customers competitors must win through tenders
Full-margin loop — lease → in-network maintenance (100k+ vehicles/yr serviced today) → remarketing via Used Lead
Vision 2030 alignment — mobility-as-a-service, EV fleet transition (Deepal + alfanar charging), Saudization of service talent
Defensive timing — middle market remains open; top-4 consolidation is closing it

slides.notes: Anchor each point to an existing asset — this is a repositioning, not a greenfield.

slides.title: Risks & Mitigations
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential
slides.notes: Two risks deserve emphasis: residual values (we are on the buy side — structural advantage) and SAMA scope creep on Fix Lead.

rows: Segment discipline: SMEs, second-tier corporates, regional cities; price on service bundles, not day-rates
Residual-value exposure in a deflating used market
Used Lead exit channel; shorter cycles for volatile segments; OEM residual risk-sharing (we sit on the buy side)
Channel conflict with Yelo and fleet customers
Formal product segmentation charter: corporate full-service only, never short-term rental
Fix Lead drifting into SAMA consumer-finance scope
Written SAMA scoping opinion before any payment-plan launch; Compliance/Legal owns the verdict
Islamic (ijara-based) facilities line secured with group bank before launch
EV residual uncertainty (30% Riyadh EV target 2030)
Cap EV share of Phase-1 fleet; Deepal + alfanar charging as controlled experiments

slides.title: CEO Vision — Prediction & Verification
slides.footer: Auto Lead Leasing — Business Case | Confidential

bullets.text: Prediction (inference, labeled as such): the group is converting from vehicle distributor to mobility company — recurring revenue, in-house vehicle data, halal-structured financing, an investable asset comparable to Budget/Theeb
Evidence pointing there: 2024–26 brand launches; Auto Lead facility build-out; automotive-finance function in place; alfanar EV-charging partnership; used-car exchange footprint
What would confirm it: a stated mobility-services ambition or finance-license plan
What would challenge it: capex austerity or near-term dividend priority
Action: verify in Phase 0 executive review before aligning the pitch — direction is sound; the debate is sequence and capital discipline

slides.notes: Frame respectfully: the vision's direction is sound; the recommendation is about gating capital, not about doubting the ambition.
